race.comment: VALOURI (8) has the most reliable recent profile, with consecutive seconds in BM58 and BM62 grade and a narrow Casino defeat by just over half a length after being sent out odds-on. This looks to shape favourably with a drop in weight and he can land the knockout blow this time around. SWIFT SOVEREIGN (3) is lightly raced and progressive, having beaten Kindred in a Mdn at Eagle Farm before another solid placing at Coffs Harbour; the quick back-up is a query, but he's got plenty of upside and can make every post a winner. MAHUIKA MAROI (7) was not beaten far in a BM58 at Casino despite racing wide and being tightened late. Rates highly on the back of that effort and won't be far away. ZHONGXIN KOALA (5) has been plain of late, but comes back from stronger BM62 and BM65 company and gets Tomizawa back aboard. Keep safe.
